# spo_storage_entity (Data Source)

Look up an existing StorageEntity object. Set identity to select it.



<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `identity` (String) Identity used to look up the object.

### Read-Only

- `comment` (String) The storage entity comment.
- `description` (String) The storage entity description.
- `id` (String) Object identifier (GUID).
- `value` (String) The storage entity value.
